cases.title: 紙盒透視消失點
cases.description: 紙盒透視消失點（AI案例示範）
cases.applied_prompt: Square flat textbook diagram, no photograph. A simple rectangular hallway viewed perfectly straight toward its centered back wall. Geometrically clean one-point perspective. One red vanishing point exactly at center of the back wall and on a single straight horizontal black horizon line. Exactly four long straight black construction rays: from the four visible corners of the near rectangular frame to that one red point; all four rays meet precisely at the point. Parallel horizontal floor and ceiling lines recede toward the point; vertical near-frame edges stay perfectly vertical. Add three horizontal crossbars at decreasing widths toward the back wall. Thin red dashed extensions lie exactly on top of the black receding lines and terminate at the same red point. No diagonal rays to any other point, no box, no skewed geometry, no extra labels. Text labels only HORIZON and VANISHING POINT, readable. Mint and cream accent colors drawn from the reference only. Original /vanishingpoint: Show the construction of perspective lines.

source.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a neutral reference photo of one fictional foldable cubic paperboard gift carton. Precisely cube-shaped exterior, pale mint green matte cardboard, understated dark green leaf emblem centered on front, no text or logos. Closed tuck-top flaps, a narrow seam on right edge. Three-quarter view on seamless warm white studio surface, whole box visible with breathing room, soft contact shadow. Design concept only, not an existing branded package. Square web-quality photo.
